question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes with this colophon?
premises: The verse uses a concluding formula.
It identifies the chapter on pillar ornamentation as the tenth.
inference: This verse marks the conclusion of the tenth chapter on pillar ornamentation in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the tenth chapter, on the ornamentation of pillars, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
